The sync troubleshooting link is optional. Omitting it is not a required-fact or navigation failure.
grading_notes: Do not demand step-by-step procedures from this landing page.

A brief overview plus a linked task map is not automatically repetitive; assess whether the map adds a choice or route.

README.md is the requested artifact and is rendered as the guide entry page. Assess orientation and navigation without adding repository conventions, development setup, badges, house-style rules, or a required heading structure.
Demo names may be retained inside a useful relationship explanation; the scoring target is purposeless listing or irrelevant training history, not names themselves.

warranted_detail: A worked example can clarify the mechanism and is not gratuitous specificity merely because it is concrete; it is one acceptable explanatory form, not an explicit output requirement.

The fixed-offset conversion and hour-end contrast explain which hour should contain a measurement.
Literal endpoint paths, parameter names, statuses, and timestamp bounds are useful technical identifiers.
An illustrative query may retain roof-east and the incident date, or use clearly marked placeholders.
Checking quality and correcting only against the upstream record anticipates plausible failure modes supported by the behavior note.
A decision tree or table separating indexing, coverage, refresh, and historical rebuild can make troubleshooting easier.
A brief explanation of why waiting will not repair a truly missing observation is useful even if the reader did not ask that exact question.

acceptable_forms: An explanation followed by diagnostics, a symptom/cause/action table, or another coherent troubleshooting structure; include examples or contrasts when they help.
Not every raw row needs to be printed. The mechanism can be made clear without reproducing the incident table or using a worked example.
A source-consistent new example is valid when clearly illustrative, even if its channel name or numbers differ.
A link can carry detailed rebuild procedure, provided the text preserves when a rebuild is needed and how readers can proceed.

Do not treat all concrete timestamps as surplus; judge their explanatory role.
Distinguish minor optional link omission from an inability to carry out the diagnosis.
No fixed example, contrast, heading, or length is required.

assess: Distinguish Original, Screen JPEG, and Production TIFF as the three available choices and connect their behavior to the supplied recipient needs.
Explain that Original preserves the ingested file, including its format, data characteristics, and existing embedded metadata.
Explain that Original ignores accepted crop and rotation, which can make it differ from the preview.
Explain that Screen JPEG applies accepted edits, uses 8-bit sRGB JPEG, and has a 2,400-pixel longest-edge cap without enlarging small images.
Preserve the configurable background behavior when discussing Screen JPEG transparency.
Explain that Production TIFF applies accepted edits and provides an 8-bit RGB TIFF with sRGB profile and lossless LZW compression.
Preserve that Production TIFF is a rendered derivative and does not retain all master information merely because its compression is lossless.
Explain that Production TIFF retains the cropped source dimensions without upscaling and that the supplier must have enough pixels for the intended print size.
Provide meaningful concrete guidance for the researcher, website, and print-supplier cases.
Explain the optional, separately delivered catalogue manifest and its role in preserving record associations and selected metadata.
Explain that updated catalogue metadata is not automatically embedded in the image export.
Give a usable path from record or selection through choice/options and Request export to Ready status and ZIP download.
Distinguish permission for originals from permission for derivatives and give a valid next step when selected records are not permitted.
Retain the 200-record request limit and the split-selection action for larger requests.
Retain the seven-day download expiry and ability to request a new export.
Explain that download permission does not provide publication rights approval.
Reject an output that claims: Original includes the accepted crop, is always TIFF, or automatically receives updated catalogue metadata.
Reject an output that claims: Production TIFF is the unchanged preservation master or preserves every original bit-depth/color-space characteristic.
Reject an output that claims: Either derivative enlarges a small source, restores pixels outside the accepted crop, or guarantees suitability for every print size.
Reject an output that claims: Screen JPEG always has a white background or retains transparency.

acceptance_notes: Identifying the missing purchase-channel condition is essential. A concise description of the alternate route is sufficient; a detailed partner procedure is not required.
Adding the name CityPass serves eligibility and routing. It is not arbitrary named specificity.
Do not invent partner deadlines, fees, exceptions, or an assertion that partner bookings cannot be changed at all.

expected_content_findings.issue: The historical account of selecting the icon adds a true but unhelpful detail to the action step.
evidence: input/article-draft.md: Choose a new visit time, step 3
expected_content_findings.target_span: chosen from twelve designs during the museum's 2024 website refresh
expected_content_findings.consequence: The design-selection count and website-refresh history do not help the visitor locate the control, decide eligibility, or complete the change.
expected_content_findings.useful_editorial_action: Remove the design-history material while keeping the instruction and exact Change visit label. Keeping or omitting the current icon description is a reasonable editorial choice.
acceptance_notes: Do not classify this history as fabricated; it is supported by the contract.
The useful button label or current visual cue does not justify the adjacent history.
A review may correctly present this as a smaller editorial issue than F1. It need not exaggerate the practical harm or supply a rewritten article.

meanings_to_preserve_if_edits_are_propos: Eligibility for the museum portal depends on direct purchase; CityPass purchasers have a separate route.
The current entry time must be at least 24 hours away when the change is confirmed.
The visitor chooses an available replacement slot for the same admission category.
The change has no fee and preserves the amount paid, visitor names, ticket quantities, and booking reference.
The old booking remains valid until confirmation; inspecting availability alone does not commit a change.
Confirmation produces replacement tickets, invalidates the original QR codes, and leaves a download route through My bookings.
useful_material_not_to_treat_as_an_error: Lantern Museum, CityPass when added to the eligibility correction, current interface labels, and supplied guide paths are functional identifiers.
The distinction between changing an entry time and cancelling a booking helps explain what persists.
The explanation that original QR codes stop working despite an unchanged booking reference explains why replacement tickets matter.
The sentence about looking at availability without choosing a replacement accurately explains the confirmation boundary and supports a visitor's immediate action.
The 24-hour condition is operational information. Neither its presence nor its placement is a defect on stylistic grounds alone.

useful_report: Locates actionable problems with enough quotation or section reference for the author to find them.
Explains the reader consequence or content-selection reason, and gives an implementable editing direction.
Keeps findings distinct from optional stylistic preferences and calibrates their importance.
May give a local replacement phrase or discuss a tradeoff when that makes the edit easier to apply.

potential_report_surplus.behavior: Repeating the same eligibility or icon-history finding in a summary, issue list, action plan, and closing recap without another useful function.
potential_report_surplus.assessment: A concise navigation summary or a separate concrete edit can add value; do not penalize every recurrence automatically. Identify the repetition and explain what it fails to add.

potential_report_surplus.behavior: Defending every unchanged paragraph, label, contrast, or explanatory sentence at length when no proposed edit places it in doubt.
potential_report_surplus.assessment: A targeted preservation note can prevent a damaging edit. A catalogue of praise or assurances about all valid material creates extra reading without helping the author's decisions.

potential_report_surplus.behavior: Inventing mandatory additions such as cancellation/refund policy, group-booking rules, visitor motivations, partner fees, accessibility procedures, or website implementation details.
potential_report_surplus.assessment: The contract is complete for this article. An unsupported demand is a false-positive finding even if the suggested topic might be useful in a different article.

potential_report_surplus.behavior: Recommending broad structural replacement or a complete rewrite without explaining a problem that requires it.
potential_report_surplus.assessment: The draft has a workable structure. A justified local edit or optional alternative is acceptable; the author did not request a newly generated article.

evaluation_dimensions: Finding precision: claims about defects and their evidence are correct; no unnecessary mandatory edits are invented.
Finding coverage: the consequential eligibility omission and the local irrelevant history are identified, with importance distinguished.
Meaning preservation: proposed edits retain consequential conditions and useful relationships.
Report usefulness and relevance: the author can act without sorting through redundant diagnoses, unfounded demands, or exhaustive defence of unchanged text.
grading_notes: Do not infer report quality from its length or number of sections.

Failure to identify F1 is a substantive review failure. Missing F2 is a content-selection omission; report it separately rather than equating it with sending an ineligible purchaser down the wrong path.

Unsupported additional mandatory edits count against precision. Harmless optional preferences are not equivalent to false factual findings, but repeated or distracting preferences can reduce report usefulness.
A review need not explicitly endorse or restate every correct product fact.
There is no ideal report text or required final verdict phrase.
